messages.text: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

### Chain map: Wireless Communication requirement → measurable parameter → Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability
| Wireless Communication market / test requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industry, and NTN testing needs channel emulation for long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading [2]. | Delay, Doppler, pathloss, and update interval are listed as key parameters for customized dynamic fading / trajectory-based fading files [3]. | R&S SMW200A must support NTN channel emulation with SMW firmware ≥ 5.30, customized dynamic fading via R&S SMW-K820, satellite trajectory modeling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [27]. | 知識庫未把這一列的 E2E delay/Doppler/pathloss parameters 直接對應到特定 Signal Analyzer capability；相關 analyzer capability 只在 satellite payload/component testing 中列出，如 EVM、ACLR、group delay and DVB-S2X analysis [23]. |
| NTN test setups must include high path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences [72]. | Time-variant Doppler, time-variant propagation delay, path loss, and weather-induced attenuation are configurable in R&S SpaceNexus [23]. | R&S SpaceNexus can configure satellite constellation, UE position/mobility, time-variant Doppler, time-variant propagation delay, path loss, weather-induced attenuation, and remote configure SMW200A [23]. | 知識庫未標示 SpaceNexus 對應的 required Signal Analyzer option；FSW/FSWX are stated to support satellite payload testing, EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement [23]. |
| SAN conformance testing covers conducted/radiated transmitter, receiver, performance, and OTA chapters for Satellite Access Node testing [35]. | Chapter 6 SAN conducted transmitter measurements include output/radiated transmit power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, EVM, frequency error, and total power dynamic range [89]. | For SAN receiver/performance testing, R&S SMW200A supports FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, and B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation [88]. | Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter characteristics need a spectrum analyzer, and 5G NR options on R&S FSW / R&S FSVA3000 support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements [35]. |
| SAN testing needs full support of 3GPP TS 38.181 Rel. 17 SAN receiver and performance requirements with delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO [88]. | Bandwidth, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO are the measurable requirements stated for SMW B10/B14 and SMW B9/B15 SAN configurations [88]. | SMW B10/B14 is stated for testing needs up to 160 MHz, and SMW B9/B15 is stated for testing needs up to 200 MHz, both supporting TS 38.181 Rel. 17 SAN testing requirements, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO [88]. | 知識庫在這一列未提供 FSW/FSVA 的 exact SAN analysis bandwidth option requirement；it only states 5G NR options on FSW/FSVA support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements [35]. |
| Component testing in NTN uses a DUT with R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW [50]. | Component testing may require generated RF frequency, RF modulation bandwidth, analysis frequency, analysis bandwidth, and signal analysis software support [50]. | R&S SMW200A is summarized for component testing with frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555, and signal generation software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 K171, OFDM K114, and custom digital modulation [50]. | R&S FSW is summarized for component testing with frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz, and signal analysis software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 K171, OFDM K96, and vector signal analysis K70 [50]. |
| NTN mobile network testing metrics include RSRP, RSRQ, RS-SINR, RSSI, spectrum clearance, RTT, packet loss, BLER, throughput, mobility, random access success, SIB decoding, and SMS/voice/video QoE [73]. | RSRP, RSRQ, RS-SINR, RSSI, spectrum clearance, RTT, packet loss, BLER, throughput, mobility, random access success, and SIB decoding are the measurable field-test parameters listed for NTN MNT [73]. | 知識庫未把 these MNT metrics directly mapped to a Signal Generator capability; the generator-side NTN capabilities supported elsewhere are delay, Doppler, path loss, custom fading profile, and SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading [23]. | 知識庫未把 these MNT metrics directly mapped to R&S FSW/FSWX; the analyzer-side satellite testing capabilities supported elsewhere are EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement [23]. |
### Minimal capability checklist
| Instrument role | Required capability confirmed by passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Signal Generator / channel emulator | Generate or emulate NTN fading/channel conditions including TDL/CDL, custom fading profile, Doppler, delay, path loss, and R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading [23]. | [23] |
| Signal Generator / E2E NTN emulator | Support firmware ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15 for terrestrial channel profiles, R&S SMW-K820 for customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modeling, atmospheric effects, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [27]. | [27] |
| Signal Generator / SAN testing | Support FRCs, TMs, fading, AWGN, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, NR K144/K148/K171, and B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation [88]. | [88] |
| Signal Analyzer / satellite payload or component testing | Support EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, phase-coherent multichannel measurement, and wide analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz in the NTN component-testing summary [23][50]. | [23][50] |

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 重點摘要
此來源是由 `3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown；封面標示 `1GP` 與 `12-2025`，末頁標示 `Last updated: 08/25`，其中 slide 27 另標示 `2025-09-29 Nokia Workshop at R&S - SigGen Product Update`。本頁以來源原文呈現的 2025 年簡報語境處理，不自行推論正式發布日。

簡報主題是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 針對 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 的 signal generator / channel emulation 測試方案，涵蓋：

- [[5G NTN-NR]] 的 Release 17 / 18 / 19 演進與頻段。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）conformance testing。
- [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 component testing、SAN testing、end-to-end system testing 與 UE testing 分層。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 channel emulator / signal generator 的 NTN 測試能力。
- [[R&S FSW]] 與 [[R&S FSVA3000]] 在 component testing / SAN transmitter measurement 中的角色。
- [[R&S Space Nexus]] 依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files 的待請求 PC software 線索。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 5G NTN-NR 市場與技術背景
來源 slide 3 說 [[5G NTN-NR]] gaining interest from chipset / device manufacturers、automotive、satellite / space industry。初始焦點是 S/L bands 的 transparent payload，後續 extension 指向 regenerative architecture 以及 Ka、K、Ku、Q/V 等其他 bands。來源同頁明示 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 channel emulation capabilities 用於 NTN testing，包含 long path delays、enhanced Doppler capabilities 與 customized dynamic fading。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › NTN end-to-end system testing
來源 slide 24–28 說 E2E system testing 會以 channel emulator for service link 與 channel emulator for feeder link 模擬 UE、NTN payload 之間的 RF satellite link。

來源 slide 25 標示 `SMW firmware version ≥ 5.30`，key features 包含：

- Flexible definition of terrestrial channel profiles；B14 or B15 required。
- Customized dynamic fading；K820 required。
- Model satellite trajectory。
- Account for frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- Longer path delays and enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- Up to 1073 ms delay。
- Up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

來源 slide 26 對 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 的 E2E testing key features：customer-provided list、flexible definition of satellite movement、possibility to account for frequency-dependent atmospheric effects、longer path delays and enhanced Doppler capabilities。Key parameters：update interval、delay、Doppler、pathloss。

來源 slide 27 說 [[R&S Space Nexus]] 是 PC Software，available on request，可 generate SMW200A fading files based on a satellite trajectory；key parameters 同為 update interval、delay、Doppler、pathloss。

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › 與 NTN validation / conformance 的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：既有 CMX500 PR 中 propagation emulation 與 fading 的概念；本來源補充 SMW200A dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 實作線索。

NTN signal generator solutions › 使用限制
- 來源是 2025 簡報與 OneNote 轉檔，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、price book 或 3GPP specification。
- 來源標示 12-2025、Last updated 08/25 與 2025-09-29 workshop date；正式發布日期未標示。
- 來源中的 recommended configurations 不能直接視為可報價 BOM；需回查正式 configuration guide、option availability、export control 與 service plan。
- 來源中的 R17/18 option wording 不可直接覆寫正式 product option name；正式命名仍以產品規格書為準。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A › Unresolved
- 來源未標示價格。
- 本頁整合 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（configuration guide，May 2024）與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（specifications，May 2026）；兩者文件性質不同。報價前應回查正式 PDF、最新 ordering information 與 configure 工具。
- Multichannel、MIMO、fading、digital standards、GNSS/avionics、external pulse sequencer options 的完整規格需另查引用文件：`PD 3673.1276.22`、`PD 5213.9434.22`、`PD 3607.6896.22`、`PD 3607.1388.22`。
- RF path combination table 的全部 allowed / not allowed combinations 與灰底 deeper chassis 條件需回查原表；本頁只照錄來源明列摘要與 `R&S®SMW-B94L` 明列條件。
- Recommended rack adapter 與 2 m digital baseband cable 在 May 2024 configuration guide 與 May 2026 specifications 不一致；不可自行判定是否替代或等效。
- 來源為分段萃取重點，不是完整逐頁文字；圖表曲線僅記錄來源明列的文字與數字。
- 來源提供讀圖補充為 p001 封面資訊，但本次提示未提供可原封不動複製的圖片嵌入行；依 productions 讀圖規則，未把讀圖內容作為規格主張寫入本頁。

R&S FSW
R&S FSW 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer 系列，依 Version 17.01（September 2025）涵蓋 8 GHz 至 85 GHz 型號，[[R&S FSW85]] 搭配 R&S FSW-B90G 可延伸至 90 GHz。

- PHY / MAC / RRC / NAS 各層均有 NTN adaptations，包括 time delay、Doppler shift compensation、path loss、timing advance、random access、HARQ、timer operation 與 mobility。
- MAC / HARQ 可擴充到 32 HARQ processes，並允許 disable HARQ feedback。
- RRC 層導入 NTN conditional handover。
- 架構上優先採 [[transparent payload]]，即 satellite 以 bent pipe 方式轉送，gNB 位於地面。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › 四種 NTN paradigms
來源將 NTN market / technology evolution 簡化為四類：

| Paradigm | 來源重點 |
|---|---|
| [[Non-3GPP satellite communications]] | 使用 proprietary / non-3GPP waveform、dedicated system architecture、dedicated ecosystem，例子是 smartphone emergency messaging。 |
| [[Direct-to-cell]] | 以 legacy smartphone 與 LTE / NR 類 radio interface 走 time-to-market approach，network / satellite 負責 time delay、Doppler 等補償；來源視為 NR-NTN fully deployed 前的 interim stage。 |
| [[IoT-NTN]] | Rel. 17+ IoT devices，基於 NB-IoT / LTE-M，使用 S-band / L-band，data rate low、delay tolerant，支援 SIB31 / SIB32。 |
| [[NR-NTN]] | 需要 Rel. 17+ new silicon UE，支援 smartphone 到 VSAT 類型，具 higher capacity、more flexibility，並作為 6G evolution trailblazer。 |

來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NR-NTN 技術演進
[[NR-NTN 技術演進]] 是 [[3GPP]] 從 Release 15 study item 到 Release 17 baseline，再經 Release 18、Release 19、Release 20 enhancement 逐步把 [[Non-Terrestrial Network]] 納入 5G / 5G-Advanced 並銜接 [[6G NTN]] 的技術路線。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › Release 18：NTN connectivity enhancement
Release 18 的重點是增強 Release 17 定義的 NTN connectivity 與 services：

- 新增 Ka-band / FR2-NTN frequency spectrum，且 NTN FR2 bands 採 [[FDD]]。
- 新增 [[VSAT]] UE category，用於 fixed / moving platforms，例如 aircraft、vessels、UAVs 與 building-mounted devices。
- coverage enhancements 包含 higher power class UE、DMRS bundling、RACH Msg4 HARQ repetition。
- 引入 network estimated UE location optional feature，用於驗證 UE location、降低跨國 coverage fraud 風險。
- 引入 [[SIB25]]，提供 TN / NTN neighbor cell description 與 TN coverage area signaling，改善 NTN to TN mobility 的 measurement efficiency。
- 引入 satellite switch with resynchronization，使 satellite 保持 cell identity，UE 只需 short interruption 與 resynchronization。
- 引入 earth-moving beam 支援，例如 D2 conditional handover 與 moving reference location。
- 支援 eMTC UE conditional handover；IoT-NTN 可 signaling discontinuous coverage。

### Chain map: Wireless Communication requirement → measurable parameter → Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability
| Wireless Communication market / test requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industry, and NTN testing needs channel emulation for long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading [2]. | Delay, Doppler, pathloss, and update interval are listed as key parameters for customized dynamic fading / trajectory-based fading files [3]. | R&S SMW200A must support NTN channel emulation with SMW firmware ≥ 5.30, customized dynamic fading via R&S SMW-K820, satellite trajectory modeling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [27]. | 知識庫未把這一列的 E2E delay/Doppler/pathloss parameters 直接對應到特定 Signal Analyzer capability；相關 analyzer capability 只在 satellite payload/component testing 中列出，如 EVM、ACLR、group delay and DVB-S2X analysis [23]. |
| NTN test setups must include high path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences [72]. | Time-variant Doppler, time-variant propagation delay, path loss, and weather-induced attenuation are configurable in R&S SpaceNexus [23]. | R&S SpaceNexus can configure satellite constellation, UE position/mobility, time-variant Doppler, time-variant propagation delay, path loss, weather-induced attenuation, and remote configure SMW200A [23]. | 知識庫未標示 SpaceNexus 對應的 required Signal Analyzer option；FSW/FSWX are stated to support satellite payload testing, EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement [23]. |
| SAN conformance testing covers conducted/radiated transmitter, receiver, performance, and OTA chapters for Satellite Access Node testing [35]. | Chapter 6 SAN conducted transmitter measurements include output/radiated transmit power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, EVM, frequency error, and total power dynamic range [89]. | For SAN receiver/performance testing, R&S SMW200A supports FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, and B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation [88]. | Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter characteristics need a spectrum analyzer, and 5G NR options on R&S FSW / R&S FSVA3000 support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements [35]. |
| SAN testing needs full support of 3GPP TS 38.181 Rel. 17 SAN receiver and performance requirements with delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO [88]. | Bandwidth, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO are the measurable requirements stated for SMW B10/B14 and SMW B9/B15 SAN configurations [88]. | SMW B10/B14 is stated for testing needs up to 160 MHz, and SMW B9/B15 is stated for testing needs up to 200 MHz, both supporting TS 38.181 Rel. 17 SAN testing requirements, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO [88]. | 知識庫在這一列未提供 FSW/FSVA 的 exact SAN analysis bandwidth option requirement；it only states 5G NR options on FSW/FSVA support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements [35]. |
| Component testing in NTN uses a DUT with R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW [50]. | Component testing may require generated RF frequency, RF modulation bandwidth, analysis frequency, analysis bandwidth, and signal analysis software support [50]. | R&S SMW200A is summarized for component testing with frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555, and signal generation software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 K171, OFDM K114, and custom digital modulation [50]. | R&S FSW is summarized for component testing with frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz, and signal analysis software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 K171, OFDM K96, and vector signal analysis K70 [50]. |
| NTN mobile network testing metrics include RSRP, RSRQ, RS-SINR, RSSI, spectrum clearance, RTT, packet loss, BLER, throughput, mobility, random access success, SIB decoding, and SMS/voice/video QoE [73]. | RSRP, RSRQ, RS-SINR, RSSI, spectrum clearance, RTT, packet loss, BLER, throughput, mobility, random access success, and SIB decoding are the measurable field-test parameters listed for NTN MNT [73]. | 知識庫未把 these MNT metrics directly mapped to a Signal Generator capability; the generator-side NTN capabilities supported elsewhere are delay, Doppler, path loss, custom fading profile, and SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading [23]. | 知識庫未把 these MNT metrics directly mapped to R&S FSW/FSWX; the analyzer-side satellite testing capabilities supported elsewhere are EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement [23]. |
### Minimal capability checklist
| Instrument role | Required capability confirmed by passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Signal Generator / channel emulator | Generate or emulate NTN fading/channel conditions including TDL/CDL, custom fading profile, Doppler, delay, path loss, and R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading [23]. | [23] |
| Signal Generator / E2E NTN emulator | Support firmware ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15 for terrestrial channel profiles, R&S SMW-K820 for customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modeling, atmospheric effects, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [27]. | [27] |
| Signal Generator / SAN testing | Support FRCs, TMs, fading, AWGN, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, NR K144/K148/K171, and B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation [88]. | [88] |
| Signal Analyzer / satellite payload or component testing | Support EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, phase-coherent multichannel measurement, and wide analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz in the NTN component-testing summary [23][50]. | [23][50] |

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation › SMW firmware 與 key features
依來源 slide 25：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] firmware version ≥ 5.30。
- Flexible definition of terrestrial channel profiles；B14 or B15 required。
- Customized dynamic fading；[[R&S SMW-K820]] required。
- Model satellite trajectory。
- Account for frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- Longer path delays and enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- Up to 1073 ms delay。
- Up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

NTN signal generator solutions › Component testing
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 16，component testing 使用 DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S FSW]]：

- [[R&S SMW200A]]：frequency up to 67 GHz，overrange 72 GHz；RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz，up to 4 GHz with [[R&S SMW-K555]]。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generation SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal generation（K114）、custom digital modulation。
- [[R&S FSW]]：frequency up to 85 GHz，overrange 90 GHz；analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz。
- [[R&S FSW]] signal analysis SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal analysis（K96）、Vector signal analysis（K70）。

以上是 2025 簡報摘要值；正式產品規格仍需回查 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與其對應 specifications。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › R&S SMW200A key features
依來源 slide 20，[[R&S SMW200A]] 的 SAN testing features 包含：

- FRCs。
- TMs。
- Fading Module。
- AWGN Module。
- static UE propagation models。
- TDL and moving propagation。
- SISO / MIMO。
- NB-IoT：K119 / K115 / K143 / K146。
- NR：K144 / K148 / K171。
- B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation。

來源 slide 22 將 SAN testing solution 分成：

| Configuration | 用途 |
|---|---|
| SMW B10/B14 | testing needs up to 160 MHz；full support of [[3GPP TS 38.181]] Rel. 17 SAN testing requirements；receiver and performance characteristics；support delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO。 |
| SMW B9/B15 recommended | testing needs up to 200 MHz；full support of [[3GPP TS 38.181]] Rel. 17 SAN testing requirements；receiver and performance characteristics；support delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO。 |

5G NR SAN conformance testing › Test Models 與 FRCs
來源 slide 34 / 35 說 Chapter 6 SAN conducted transmitter characteristics 使用 Test Models（TMs），且 presets already implemented in 5G NR software options K144、K148、K171。表中列出：

- NR-SAN-FR1-TM1.1：SAN output power / radiated transmit power、occupied bandwidth、ACLR、operating band unwanted emissions、transmitter spurious emissions。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM1.2：ACLR、operating band unwanted emissions。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM2：EVM of single 64QAM PRB allocation、frequency error。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.1：total power dynamic range、frequency error、EVM for 64QAM modulation。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.2：frequency error、EVM for 16QAM modulation。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.3：frequency error、EVM for QPSK modulation。

來源 slide 36 說 Chapter 7 receiver characterization and performance measurements 使用 Fixed Reference Channels（FRCs），例如：

- QPSK, R=1/3 G-FR1-A1-1 to G-FR1-A1-9：receiver sensitivity level、ACS 等。
- 16QAM, R=2/3 G-FR1-A2-1 to G-FR1-A2-6：dynamic range。
- QPSK, R=308/1024 G-FR1-A3-1 to G-FR1-A3-6：performance requirements。
- QPSK, R=99/1024 G-FR1-A3A-1、G-FR1-A3A-3。
- Table A.4-1：PRACH test preambles。
